args.body:
File: src/exportUtils.ts

Change formatting of the export filename to use a local date adjusted to the appropriate timezone instead of using toISOString(), which uses UTC, causing the file date to be a day ahead in late hours in timezones behind UTC (such as Los Angeles). This ensures the export filename date matches the exporter local date.

args.title: Fix report duplication for long names to add '(copy)' suffix correctly
args.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

When duplicating reports with names close to the 120-character limit, the copy's name incorrectly ends with `...` instead of `(copy)`. Change duplication logic to truncate the base report name to make room for the suffix `(copy)` without exceeding the limit, ensuring the copy's name is distinguishable in the list.
